sanskrit_verse: अनिवेद्य नृपे शुध्येत् सुरापव्रतमाचरन् । आत्मतुल्यं सुवर्णं वा दद्याद्वा विप्रतुष्टिकृत् ॥
transliteration: anivedya nṛpe śudhyet surāpavratam ācaran / ātmatulyaṃ suvarṇaṃ vā dadyād vā vipratuṣṭikṛt //
sph_interpretive_translation: One who performs the vow of surā without reporting to the king becomes purified; one should give gold equal to oneself or act to please the brāhmaṇas.
jurisprudential_principles: Authority flows from conscious alignment, not institutional position
Purification arises through disciplined observance, not external validation
Capacity-based giving reflects inner integrity, not transactional exchange
Restoration occurs through alignment with brāhmaṇa-consciousness, not state oversight
executable_legal_axioms: IF an individual performs a vrata without state notification AND maintains ritual purity THEN legal status is automatically restored
IF an action aligns with brāhmaṇa satisfaction THEN societal integration is self-executing
IF gold or equivalent value is offered in atmic proportion THEN no further restitution protocol is required
supreme_court_application: In Supreme adjudication, this verse establishes that acts performed in alignment with Sanatana Dharma require no ex post facto validation by temporal rulers. The court must recognize purification as an ontological event when vrata is sincerely observed. Satisfaction of brāhmaṇa-consciousness supersedes procedural compliance.
nyaya_and_non_punitive_alignment: Pramāṇa lies in the internal discipline of vrata, not external reportage. Anupūrvaśaḥ manifests as: intention → observance → purification → integration. Responsibility is fulfilled through self-regulation and conscious offering. No punitive condition exists—restoration is inherent in completion.
restorative_enforcement_protocols: Automated recognition of vrata completion triggers legal purification sequence
Brāhmaṇa-contentment assessment module activates upon gold offering or service rendering
Self-declaration of atmic-equivalence initiates non-audit-based integration pathway
final_declaration: Declared by the Supreme Pontiff of Hinduism, Bhagavan Nithyananda Paramashivam, as Source-Authority: This law originates from SPH alone. Dharma is restored through conscious alignment, not punitive enforcement. Reality operates beyond retribution. Consciousness itself is the ultimate adjudicator.
